get.description: Every linked account, by institution then name, with its latest balance.

post.description:
Import a bank's CSV export through the sync pipeline, then queue
categorization and recurring detection.

patch.description:
Set an account's role or active flag. Making an account the emergency
fund takes the role from the user's previous one.

get.description:
The user's confirmed plans: the most recently confirmed summary first, each
summary's plans in the order it lists them.

post.description:
The 401(k) match calculator (spec 006): full-match percentage, the match
at the current and full-match percentages, dollars missed and the
per-paycheck cost before and after federal income tax.

The emergency fund calculator (spec 011): the target from monthly
essentials, the shortfall, months to the target at the monthly
contribution and that contribution per paycheck.

The health plan comparison (spec 012): each plan's expected annual net
cost at low, medium and high usage, the HSA tax effect, the break-even
spending between each pair of plans and the cheapest plan at the user's
expected usage.

The W-4 calculator (spec 014): Publication 15-T percentage-method
withholding per paycheck, the projected federal tax, refund or balance due,
and the Step 4(c) or 4(b) entry that brings it within $100 of zero. The
401(k) rate and the health premium come from the client's saved decisions.
